sampleNotice: Sample data only. Entries have not been independently verified and may not reflect current rules. Confirm with the destination's official government source before making travel plans.
disclaimer: Visa and entry requirements can change without notice. Visa Expeditor summarises official sources for general guidance only. The official source and the destination's border authorities are the final authority. Always confirm before booking or travelling.
notAdmittedNotice: The dataset records entry as not permitted. This status needs manual review before you make plans: check the official source and contact the destination's authorities. Do not rely on this page alone.
emptyHeading: Choose a destination to view entry requirements
emptyBody: Browse the destinations below or choose one above. Confirm all requirements with official sources before travel.
notFoundBody: Choose a destination from the list to check whether a record is available.
noDataBody: There is no matching dataset row for this passport, destination and travel purpose. We do not infer missing requirements. Contact us if you would like to ask about assistance.
resultHeading: {purpose} entry information for {passport} passport holders traveling to {destination}

checklist.heading: Before you travel
checklist.passport: Check your passport's validity against official requirements.
checklist.purpose: Confirm the purpose of travel matches the application category.
checklist.officialSource: Review the latest instructions on the destination government's website.

importedNotice: Compiled from official sources by TravelRequirements.info and mapped by Visa Expeditor. Imported rows were checked against the linked source by the dataset provider, but Visa Expeditor has not independently verified every row. The official source is the authority.
verifiedNotice: Independently verified by Visa Expeditor against the linked official source.
